Senior Software Test Engineer – Retail Data Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Milford Proving Ground in Milford, MI three times per week, at minimum. The Role Help shape the future of transportation at GM. The AV Fleet Data Engineering Team is responsible for defining, integrating, and validating Retail AV Data Collection pipelines that power automated driving development at scale. We are seeking a Senior Software Test Engineer to lead automation and execution of vehicle-based and cloud‑connected data collection systems. The Senior Software Test Engineer is responsible for building and executing validation strategies for GM’s on-vehicle and bench-based data recording stack (RADC and ASDR), with a focus on automated test development, CI/CD, and end-to-end data quality and performance benchmarking . The role spans bench and vehicle integration , OTA release validation , and deep data analysis , leveraging AI agents and automation tooling to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort. The engineer works closely with SW and platform teams to ensure robust, scalable data collection in support of current and future ADAS/AV programs. What You'll Do Own RADC validation for key programs including test planning, execution (bench and vehicle), and defect triage for data recording behavior. Develop, maintain, and extend RADC CI/CD and validation automation (Autobot, ATP/Jenkins), including reusable pipelines, scripts, and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate test authoring, log triage, and report generation. Lead CI/CD bench readiness for RADC benches: ensure hardware and software baselines are aligned with target configurations, flashing flows are automated and reliable, and benches are continuously available for automated regression and feature validation. Design and execute performance and quality benchmarks for VTM tasks (e.g., 1411 HoLCA and 1414 SC OpStats), including test definition, drive/bench execution, and analysis of upload latency, completeness, and data integrity. Set up and maintain RADC benches , including ECU wiring, power supply and relay integration, Autobot keyword integration, and ensuring the bench is representative of fleet configurations for test campaigns. Integrate new camera and consent features into benches and test plans, including Autobot/Robot test development and Confluence/Jira documentation of procedures. Author and maintain technical documentation and training content (bench setup guides, test repositories, SDV2 execution planning notes, Xray repository structure) to scale data-recording validation across teams and programs. Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to align validation priorities, communicate risk, and drive closure on complex multi-team issues. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Computer/Software Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience. Minimum of 5 years of engineering/technical experience Hands-on experience with on-vehicle or bench and interpreting associated logs and metrics. Proficiency in scripting/automation (Python, Robot Framework, or similar) for test authoring, data analysis, and tooling glue code. What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) Experience with CI/CD and test automation frameworks (e.g., Jenkins/ATP, Autobot, Xray) and maintaining bench environments as CI/CD targets (agent setup, flashing automation, health checks, monitoring). Demonstrated ability to debug complex, cross-component issues (signals, consent, memory, OTA, deployment) and drive them to resolution across multiple teams. Familiarity with Azure-hosted data lakes, Centra dashboards, and Elastic/Xray-based analysis for large-scale data quality and performance evaluation. Experience applying AI agents and LLM-based tools to engineering workflows (e.g., log summarization, test-case generation, documentation, pipeline or config generation), with a bias toward measurable automation and efficiency gains . Proven experience training or mentoring others on tools, processes, or architecture (e.g., running internal trainings, authoring how-to guides, leading forums). Demonstrated orientation toward continuous improvement and technical leadership , including identifying process gaps and driving automation/efficiency initiatives. San Mateo, CA (Hybrid)
Overview:
As a Staff Data Scientist on the Decision Science team at PlayStation, you will take a leading role in designing and interpreting experiments that evaluate the impact of key initiatives and programs. You’ll help shape how millions of players around the world experience PlayStation by bringing statistical rigor, clear measurement strategies, and deep causal inference expertise to some of the most critical initiatives across the company. This highly visible role will advance our experimentation practices and ensure that data-driven insights inform the way we build, market, and evolve our products.

Partner with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, marketing) to embed experimentation into development and iteration cycles and communicate results with the company’s senior leadership.
Mentor and guide other Data Scientists, providing thought leadership and technical direction.
Serve as a thought leader on best practices for hypothesis development, metric selection, test structure, and results communication.
Help define and contribute to centralized experimentation frameworks, tools, and documentation to scale best practices across the company.
Independently extract, transform, and analyze data from complex systems using SQL, Python, and other analytics tools.
Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping drive business decisions with rigor and clarity.
Stay current on new methodologies in experimentation and causal analysis, and bring fresh perspectives to the team’s work.
Your insights will directly influence how PlayStation builds, markets, and evolves products across our ecosystem.

degree or equivalent.

Deep expertise in A/B testing and causal inference, including quasi-experimental methods.

Broad and applied knowledge of statistical techniques.

Proven ability to influence product and business decisions through clear, actionable insights.
Experience contributing to or developing experimentation frameworks, best practices, or internal tooling.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
Display Marketing팀은 Growth Marketing 내에서 페이드 소셜 및 디스플레이 플랫폼을 관리하며 쿠팡의 전체 매출 목표 달성에 기여하는 부서입니다.
플랫폼 전반에 걸친 최고 수준의 증분성 측정(Incrementality measurement)을 통해 결과의 타당성을 확보하는 동시에, 항상 높은 목표를 설정하고 도전하고 있습니다. 또한 디스플레이 마케팅팀은 성장 목표를 달성하기 위해 프로덕트 및 애널리틱스 팀과 밀접하게 협업하며 타겟 오디언스 최적화 및 상품 피드 노출을 위한 맞춤형 솔루션을 구축합니다.

소셜 및 디스플레이 플랫폼 내 광고 운영 및 목표별(신규 고객 발굴, 리타겟팅, 신규 고객 확보) 캠페인 전략 수립
GMV, ROAS, 신규 고객 확보 목표 달성을 위한 효율성 제고 및 퍼포먼스 타겟 달성
담당 채널의 모든 광고 관련 이슈 트러블슈팅 및 해결
올바른 의사결정을 위한 리포팅 및 대시보드 구축
실행된 액션의 증분성을 측정하여 효율성을 극대화하기 위한 적절한 테스트 설계
적절한 플랫폼에서 최적의 타겟에게 도달하기 위한 오디언스 관리 인프라 구축

빠르게 성장하는 환경에서 근무한 경험이 있으며, 고객 인게이지먼트를 위한 온라인 마케팅 지식을 바탕으로 주도적이고 기민하게 업무를 추진할 수 있으신 분

jobs.description: At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you. What's in it for you? An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus. About the team Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon at Amazon - including Graviton (our server processors), Trainium and Inferentia (our machine learning training and inference accelerators), and the Nitro system that powers modern EC2. We own the full stack, from silicon through the software that makes it work (compilers, runtimes, drivers, and the frameworks that let customers run workloads on our hardware). As an ASIC Engineer I, you'll write the programs that turns custom silicon into products used by millions. Annapurna has ASIC teams across a range of products and disciplines, and we work to place you on a technical team aligned with your interests and strengths. Example teams and focus areas include: - RTL design for machine learning accelerators (Trainium/Inferentia) - Design verification and functional validation - Physical design, timing closure, and place-and-route - SoC integration and chip architecture Throughout the interview process, we will partner with you and our hiring managers to match you to a team where your background and interests fit best, so your responsibilities are something you're genuinely excited to work on. As an ASIC Engineer I, you'll contribute to real chip development work, which may include: - Designing and implementing RTL for digital logic blocks using Verilog/SystemVerilog - Developing and running verification environments to validate design functionality and coverage - Supporting synthesis, timing analysis, and physical design flows - Debugging design issues through simulation and analysis - Collaborating with architecture, verification, and physical design teams to take features from specification to silicon - Documenting your design decisions and presenting your work to the team

jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Vice President, Product Development, Switching as a Service Overview and Context As part of the Network Products business unit, the Next Generation Network Team is at the heart of Mastercard’s transformation, driving innovation and modernization to ensure the network remains resilient, flexible, and competitive in a rapidly evolving payments landscape. This team is responsible for building Mastercard’s next-generation unified switch and access capabilities, designed to handle all payment and related data flows across transaction types and payment schemes. Within Next Gen Network, the Network Expansion team is driving Product Development for a new product named “Switching as a Service” (SwaaS), which opens a new business model in which Mastercard leverages its next-generation platform to switch domestic payment schemes according to their rules, interchange, and settlement, hosted and operated by Mastercard. Network Products has signed its first large and strategic SwaaS contract and needs to grow its Product Development team to manage its design, build, and run activities. Role Summary This VP role will lead a team having Product Development accountability for the Core Switching and Data-related services of the SwaaS. The role will ensure delivery of this scope according to the contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions. Given the large scope and complexity of SwaaS, this individual will partner closely with a large network of actors, such as: other SwaaS Product Development team members managing other parts of the SwaaS, Avanti project management structure, representative from Product and Engineering of each contributing program, Regional lead driving the on-soil relationship with the SwaaS customer and providing product management and GTM role, Customer delivery, Global Customer Care, Security, Network, etc. The individual will also have direct relationship with representatives from the SwaaS customer team to ensure full alignment between their expectations and our solutioning while protecting Mastercard’s interest and goals. This SwaaS project spread across multiple time zones. The role demands a strong product mindset, drive, structure, organization, technical acumen across the scope, and will require a high degree of collaboration across technical, customer-facing, and other stakeholder teams to bring the first SwaaS implementation to home. Key Responsibilities • Lead the Product Development team in charge of the Core Switching and Data-related capabilities of the SwaaS product from intake through elaboration, execution, build, and run. • Within the SwaaS governance, provide regular & detailed reporting, stay ahead in risk management, and ensure that the resources allocated to SwaaS execution are rightly used in partnership with PMO’s and Finance. • Own delivery of the allocated scope and coordinate with Product Management and Engineering teams to meet contracted milestones, deliverables, and conditions. • Ensure the integrity and consistency of SwaaS delivery across vision, capabilities, scalability, performance, speed-to-market, readiness for growth, and reusability. • Build and maintain detailed functional and technical understanding of the delivered platform, including requirements, use cases, architecture, dependencies, interfaces, data flows, runtime operations, support strategies, and maintenance needs. • Drive stakeholder alignment across the SwaaS ecosystem, including Product, Engineering, Franchise, Global Customer Delivery, Privacy, and other contributing teams. • Lead by example with a hands-on approach, demonstrate product management excellence, and share best practices. • Apply logic, reasoning, and sound decision-making to develop solutions with all teams. Clarify concepts and build a shared understanding of what will ultimately be delivered. • Define capabilities that enhance the Next Gen platform, respect the platform strategy and principles, and ensure platform integrity. • Support other SwaaS Product team members to ensure collective success. Replicate knowledge, share workload across initiatives, provide mutual backup, and help the team scale, learn, and expand its scope. • Establish product development discipline in the team, including clear methods, structure, content standards, reliable execution, and high-quality on-time contributions. • Recruit, develop, and retain high-performance team while fostering a culture of execution, accountability, and innovation. • Identify opportunities for leveraging AI to improve speed, efficiency and quality. All About You • Fluent in English • 10+ years of product development or product management experience in complex, geographically distributed environments • Experience managing and developing teams. People leader. • Executive-level stakeholder management and influence in a matrixed organization • Expected to bring a strong execution mindset, sound judgment, and practical problem-solving skills • Strong technical foundation required to understand complex platform capabilities, dependencies, and delivery risks • Prior experience in payments and/or fintech is required; experience with card processing systems, including authorization, clearing, and settlement, is preferred • Proven ability to lead cross-functional alignment across product and engineering teams, including dependency management • Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities • Strong problem solver who can navigate complexity, unblock teams, and identify alternative paths to deliver the outcomes • Strong experience with complex technical products and customer integration planning is a plus • Excellent analytical, organizational, and workstream management skills • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate problem statements, frame options and trade-off, and engage internal and external stakeholders clearly. • Customer-facing experience is preferred • Ability to work with ambiguity and manage complex projects in fast-paced environments • Demonstrated ability to work independently and with minimal day-to-day supervision • Ability to build effective relationships with senior leaders, internal teams, and external clients • Flexibility to work with multiple time zones Location: Pune only Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
